claims.citation: New York Herald, 7 July 1866, p. 1, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Cunard steamship Corsica, Captain Le Messurier,
from Havana June 30, reached this port yesterday, bring-
ing later news from Tampico to the 19th, Mexico City to
the 22d, and Vera Cruz to the 26th of June.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 7 July 1866, p. 4, col. 1
